model_name: AmpAB100 — 100W Class-AB Linear Audio Power Amplifier
tagline: 100W Linear Class-AB Audio Power Amplifier with Balanced Input & Peak Telemetry
description: High-fidelity 100W linear Class-AB audio power amplifier module engineered for clean, low-distortion loudspeaker drive. Combines a heatsink-cooled analog output stage, symmetrical dual-rail power filtering, balanced XLR audio input, hardware mute/standby controls, and optical peak level indicators.
key_components: 100W Linear Class-AB Output Stage + Finned Heatsink
Balanced XLR Audio Input & Symmetrical Power Stage
Analog Optical Peak & Level Telemetry Array
engineering_note: Low-noise analog layout separating the balanced audio input front-end from the high-current power supply and speaker output paths.
